info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Authorization Details API
info.description: The Customer Authorization Details API provides detailed authorization information for customer institution logins. By accessing this endpoint, users can retrieve authorization status, applicable limits, and relevant transaction history associated with specific logins. This API is essential for financial institutions, account managers, and compliance teams to ensure secure and transparent monitoring of login activities. Typical use cases include auditing access and validating user permissions within customer accounts.

get.summary: Retrieve authorization details for a specific institution login.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to obtain the authorization details associated with a specific institution login, identified by its unique resource ID. It provides insights into the login status and associated authorization information for better management and troubleshooting.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the authorization details.

authorizationEndDate.description: The end date of the authorization.
